title: Z9.F telescoper — Actual cleared rational representation
milestone_description: For every $n\ge1$, rational polynomial $W$ and rational $t$ regular at every $t+k$, $0\le k<n$, the actual cumulative rational function equals $P_{n,W}(t)/M_n(t)^9$. Both the numerator and denominator are defined from the actual local coefficients and pole products. No Even n, strong bound, zero aggregate or preassigned rational identity is needed for this original endpoint.
